name: io.github.CyberPunk11147/cyberwarex-web-access
description: MCP server for CyberWareX Agent Web-Access: render JS pages to markdown/text/HTML, CSS extract, screenshot (PNG), and PDF any public URL. Tools: web_fetch, web_extract, web_screenshot, web_pdf.
